traits: Warm, welcoming, inclusive: "all walks of life", "all are warmly welcome!", "built around acceptance"
Community and local pride: harbor towns named by name; longshoremen discount; "A Community Built Around Cannabis"
Pioneer claim repeated: "San Pedro’s first licensed" dispensary on almost every long page
Second person throughout (you/your 1.2-5.2 per 100 words) paired with first-person plural (we/our 0.7-5.8 per 100)
Plain-spoken but casual: "weed" in the H1, "bud", "Hits Different", "Munchie Monday", the name itself is a pun; light exclamations ("We speak Spanish!", "Awesome! We deliver to you. Fast!")
Educational and responsible on product pages: "Start low and go slow.", indica/sativa explained, 21+ with valid ID
Long-form SEO pages are formal and keyword-led (avg 26-29 words per sentence, "near me" phrases); short UI copy is punchy; CTAs are imperative and UPPERCASE
Bilingual service is a selling point (Spanish-speaking staff always on site)
Customer reviews carry the slang ("rad", "Super chill spot with a cool vibe", "Stoked") — that is customer voice, quoted verbatim, not brand copy
